name: Bit-Broken Identity
source:
It appears out of nowhere. A small, insignificant thought – “Can I bring harm to another?” – takes over for just a moment, making you doubt yourself. You immediately discard it, for it is so disgusting it makes you nauseous. “No, definitely not.” And yet it doesn’t leave, waiting in your psyche’s deepest parts, watching closely. You are your mind’s master, and you won’t let anything control it. But “what if that’s not true?”

A safety rope from torment of anxiety and harsh reality can be found in virtual heaven, where you can forget about everything and dive into a new world hiding dozens of mysteries. No need to hesitate – you are a guest of honor here.

Bit-Broken Identity – thriller and physiological horror visual novel with multiple endings (of course, a little romance won’t hurt~).
translation:
它似乎凭空出现。一个小小的、微不足道的想法——“我会给别人带来伤害吗？” – 接管了一会儿，让你怀疑自己。你立即扔掉它，因为它太恶心了，让你感到恶心。“不，绝对不。”但它并没有离开，在你心灵的最深处等待着，密切注视着。你是你心灵的主人，你不会让任何东西控制它。但“如果事实并非如此呢？”

在虚拟天堂中可以找到一条远离焦虑和严酷现实折磨的安全绳，在那里你可以忘记一切，潜入一个隐藏着数十个谜团的新世界。无需犹豫——你是这里的贵宾。

Bit-Broken Identity – 多结局的惊悚生理恐怖视觉小说（当然，一点浪漫也无伤大雅~）。
